cases.question: Units sold by customer country with playlist membership

telemetry.model_cost_basis: local inference; hardware and electricity excluded

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "InvoiceLineId", "InvoiceId", "TrackId", "UnitPrice", "Quantity" FROM "InvoiceLine"), __grouped AS (SELECT t2."Country" AS "customer_country", COALESCE(SUM(t0."Quantity"), 0) AS "units_sold" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "Invoice" t1 ON t0."InvoiceId" COLLATE BINARY = t1."InvoiceId" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "Track" t3 ON t0."TrackId" COLLATE BINARY = t3."TrackId" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "Customer" t2 ON t1."CustomerId" COLLATE BINARY = t2."CustomerId" COLLATE BINARY WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "PlaylistTrack" e0 WHERE e0."TrackId" COLLATE BINARY = t3."TrackId" COLLATE BINARY) GROUP BY t2."Country") SELECT "customer_country", "units_sold" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "units_sold" DESC, "customer_country" ASC LIMIT :result_limit
result.explanation: Sum of purchased quantities at invoice-line grain.
result.title: Units sold by Customer country

cases.oracle_sql: SELECT c.Country AS customer_country, SUM(l.Quantity) AS units_sold FROM InvoiceLine l LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON l.InvoiceId=i.InvoiceId LEFT JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId=c.CustomerId LEFT JOIN Track t ON l.TrackId=t.TrackId WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlaylistTrack p WHERE p.TrackId=t.TrackId) GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY units_sold DESC, customer_country ASC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Revenue by category for lines with damaged returns

telemetry.model_cost_basis: local inference; hardware and electricity excluded

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "line_id", "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "line_total_cents" FROM "order_items"), __grouped AS (SELECT t5."category_label" AS "category", ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(t0."line_total_cents"), 0) / :scale_revenue), 2) AS "revenue" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "products" t4 ON t0."product_id" COLLATE BINARY = t4."product_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "categories" t5 ON t4."category_id" COLLATE BINARY = t5."category_id" COLLATE BINARY WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "returns" e0 WHERE e0."line_id" COLLATE BINARY = t0."line_id" COLLATE BINARY AND e0."reason" = :related_0) GROUP BY t5."category_label") SELECT "category", "revenue" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "revenue" DESC, "category" ASC LIMIT :result_limit
result.explanation: Sum of order-line totals in dollars, before refunds, across every order status unless filtered.
result.title: Revenue by Category

cases.oracle_sql: SELECT c.category_label AS category,ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(li.line_total_cents),0)/100.0,2) AS revenue FROM order_items li LEFT JOIN products p ON li.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id=c.category_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM returns re WHERE re.line_id=li.line_id AND re.reason='Damaged') GROUP BY c.category_label ORDER BY revenue DESC,category ASC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Order lines including current and archived records with exact duplicates removed

telemetry.model_cost_basis: local inference; hardware and electricity excluded

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "line_id", "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "line_total_cents" FROM "order_items" UNION SELECT "line_id", "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "line_total_cents" FROM "archived_order_items"), __grouped AS (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(1), 0) AS "line_count" FROM __facts t0) SELECT "line_count" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "line_count" DESC LIMIT :result_limit
result.explanation: Number of selected order-line records, including duplicate rows when UNION ALL is requested. Includes current and archived fact rows; exact duplicate rows are removed.
result.title: Order lines

cases.oracle_sql: WITH all_lines AS (SELECT line_id,order_id,product_id,quantity,line_total_cents FROM order_items UNION SELECT line_id,order_id,product_id,quantity,line_total_cents FROM archived_order_items) SELECT COUNT(1) AS line_count FROM all_lines

cases.question: Billed amount by account segment for lines with service issue credits

telemetry.model_cost_basis: local inference; hardware and electricity excluded

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "entry_id", "invoice_id", "subscription_id", "seat_quantity", "amount_cents" FROM "invoice_lines"), __grouped AS (SELECT t2."segment" AS "segment", ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(t0."amount_cents"), 0) / :scale_billed_amount), 2) AS "billed_amount" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "invoices" t1 ON t0."invoice_id" COLLATE BINARY = t1."invoice_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "accounts" t2 ON t1."account_id" COLLATE BINARY = t2."account_id" COLLATE BINARY WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "credits" e0 WHERE e0."entry_id" COLLATE BINARY = t0."entry_id" COLLATE BINARY AND e0."reason" = :related_0) GROUP BY t2."segment") SELECT "segment", "billed_amount" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "billed_amount" DESC, "segment" ASC LIMIT :result_limit
result.explanation: Sum of invoice-line amounts in dollars before credits, across every invoice status unless filtered.
result.title: Billed amount by Account segment

cases.oracle_sql: SELECT a.segment,ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents),0)/100.0,2) AS billed_amount FROM invoice_lines li LEFT JOIN invoices i ON li.invoice_id=i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON i.account_id=a.account_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM credits c WHERE c.entry_id=li.entry_id AND c.reason='Service issue') GROUP BY a.segment ORDER BY billed_amount DESC,segment ASC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Break down revenue geographically.

telemetry.model_cost_basis: local inference; hardware and electricity excluded

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "line_id", "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "line_total_cents" FROM "order_items"), __grouped AS (SELECT t3."region_label" AS "region", ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(t0."line_total_cents"), 0) / :scale_revenue), 2) AS "revenue" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "orders" t1 ON t0."order_id" COLLATE BINARY = t1."order_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "customers" t2 ON t1."customer_id" COLLATE BINARY = t2."customer_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "regions" t3 ON t2."region_id" COLLATE BINARY = t3."region_id" COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t3."region_label") SELECT "region", "revenue" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "revenue" DESC, "region" ASC LIMIT :result_limit
result.explanation: Sum of order-line totals in dollars, before refunds, across every order status unless filtered.
result.title: Revenue by Region

cases.oracle_sql: SELECT r.region_label AS region,ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(li.line_total_cents),0)/100.0,2) AS revenue FROM order_items li LEFT JOIN orders o ON li.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON c.region_id=r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_label ORDER BY revenue DESC,region ASC LIMIT 100
